change: Resilience4j — Repeat a circuit-breaker command without creating another transition
assumptions: One synchronous public listener, original default state machine, one fresh breaker per history. No automatic transitions or external calls.

questions.history: Report return or exception, state and cumulative listener count after each of six commands, followed by the full transition sequence.
Read state and events around a genuinely invalid CLOSED to HALF_OPEN and an ordinary three-transition cycle.
